sections.title: Player-facing description
sections.body: Three falcons watch from charred branches. Their feathers glow at the edges like coals under ash, and every head turns at once.

sections.title: Handout text
sections.body: Player-safe note: Sleek ember-orange falcons with coal-black wing tips and feather edges like banked fire, beautiful enough for prestige and sharp enough to make a cache feel watched.

sections.title: GM truth

sections.title: GM handling
sections.body: Use as prestige and warning-light pressure for the Sable Sinecure; they signal danger before they become danger.
